column1: # ZAP baseline rule tuning for ABC Agent Builder Console
# Format: <rule-id>\t<threshold>\t<comment>
# Thresholds: IGNORE | WARN | FAIL
# Rule IDs are documented at https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/
# Approach: start strict. Loosen specific rules only with a comment explaining
# why. Every rule that's set to IGNORE here should have a tracking note in
# docs/security/dast_findings.md.
# False positives in the ZAP baseline pass against an Express app
# 10049: Non-Storable Content. ZAP flags every response that lacks an explicit
# Cache-Control header. The Helmet middleware sets sensible defaults; we
# explicitly override Cache-Control on the few responses that need it (e.g.
# the FOIP export which sets `no-store`). The default flagged-as-warning here
# is noise.

column3: Helmet sets defaults; explicit no-store on sensitive responses

column1: # 10027: Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments. Triggers on any
# response body that contains words like "TODO" / "FIXME". Our route handlers
# are minified in prod via tsc → js; no source comments leak. The check is
# too noisy on the dev-mode static assets.

column3: Triggers on dev-mode comments; tighten to FAIL after Nexus deploy hardens build

column1: # 10038: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set. Tracked as backlog S1
# (CSP headers via Helmet). Until that lands, this is a known gap — we want
# the report to flag it but not break the build.

column3: Tracking via backlog S1; remove after CSP lands

column1: # Hard fails — these should never regress
# 10202: Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens. Cookie-session auth needs same-site
# + secure cookies, which Helmet + the express-session config provide. Any
# regression here is a real bug.
# 90019: Server Side Code Injection. Critical — any positive here is a real bug.
# 90020: Remote OS Command Injection.
# 90022: Application Error Disclosure. The global error handler in
# backend/src/index.ts redacts stack traces in production; this rule
# guards against regressions where a stack escapes to the wire.

column3: Stack traces must not leak in production
